notablePrerequisites:
Three loyalty counters on Moritte of the Frost.
Any creature on the battlefield has 1 or 2 power.
description:
Activate Moritte of the Frost's first loyalty ability by adding 0 loyalty counters, dealing 3 damage to target creature and having that creature deal 1 or 2 damage to Moritte of the Frost.
Moritte of the Frost triggers but fails to transform.
You must repeat the last step in a mandatory loop, resulting in a game draw.
